北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 天阴微热，注意防晒，记得多喝水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: It's cloudy and a bit warm. Remember to stay hydrated and protect yourself from the sun!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 烈日炎炎，体感很热！注意防暑防晒，及时补水。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: It's scorching hot! Stay cool, protect from sun, and hydrate well.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 晴热高温，体感更热！记得防晒补水，注意防暑哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and very hot, feels even warmer! Remember sun protection, hydration, and heatstroke prevention.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗炎热，体感不低。多喝水，防晒防暑要做好哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and hot, feels quite warm. Stay hydrated and take care with sun protection and heatstroke prevention!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 晴热天气，风力稍大。注意防晒，及时补充水分哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and hot with moderate wind. Remember sun protection and timely hydration!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 酷热难耐！体感直逼 40℃，务必多喝水，严防中暑。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Extremely hot! Feels close to 40°C. Drink plenty of water and strictly prevent heatstroke.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 气温虽 28℃，体感却闷热。湿度高，注意防潮防蚊哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Although it's 28°C, it feels muggy. High humidity, watch out for dampness and mosquitoes!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 高温预警！体感 42℃，太热了！多补水，尽量室内活动。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Heatwave alert! Feels like 42°C, it's scorching! Hydrate well and stay indoors if possible.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 多云炎热，体感温度高。请注意防晒补水，小心中暑。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and hot with high apparent temperature. Please remember sun protection, hydration, and beware of heatstroke.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 晴空万里，高温炎热。请多喝水，避免长时间户外活动。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Clear skies, hot and sunny. Please drink plenty of water and avoid prolonged outdoor activities.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 酷热难耐，气温 40℃！体感更热，请务必防暑降温。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Unbearably hot, temperature at 40°C! Feels even hotter, please prioritize heatstroke prevention and cooling down.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 大雨倾盆，路面湿滑。出门记得带伞，注意交通安全。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Heavy rain is pouring, roads are slippery. Remember your umbrella and watch out for traffic safety.
哈尔滨.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 天气阴沉，体感微热。外出别忘带伞，以防阵雨哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and feels slightly warm. Don't forget an umbrella when going out, just in case of showers!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 天气阴凉舒适，体感宜人。享受好天气，心情棒棒哒！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy, cool, and comfortable, feels pleasant. Enjoy the good weather and have a great mood!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 天阴微热，湿度较高。出门带伞，注意防晒和补水。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and slightly warm with high humidity. Bring an umbrella, remember sun protection and hydration.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 天气阴沉，湿度 89%，体感闷热。注意防潮防蚊哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy with 89% humidity, feels muggy. Watch out for dampness and mosquitoes!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 天阴湿度大，体感稍闷。出门带件薄外套，注意防潮。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy with high humidity, feels a bit muggy. Bring a light jacket and watch out for dampness.
